title: Harness doctor forbidden-path rule repair
objective: Repair the existing Harness doctor false positive with the narrowest auditable rule: preserve raw/private-data detection, distinguish only documented scrubbed public fixture/aggregate artifacts, and prove that synthetic raw wallet-like files remain rejected. Do not silently waive the doctor gate.
forbidden_actions: Do not weaken secret, credential, raw export, wallet-address, transaction, or private-data retention controls.
Do not allowlist arbitrary directories or wildcard names without narrowly tested scrubbed-artifact justification.
Do not modify product source, provider behavior, runtime credential handling, chain configuration, or package scripts.
Do not push main, merge, squash, rebase, or rewrite pushed history.
Do not simply remove `wallet*.json` or disable the forbidden-file check.
Do not rename or delete existing evidence files merely to hide the failure.
